name: terminal
label: Terminal
tagline: Your shell, in tabs, inside Forge

help.about: Your computer's command line, in tabs inside Forge, with split panes and find in the scrollback.

auto_close.why: closing it ends your open shells

manifest.summary: Real login shells in tabs and split panes inside Forge (xterm.js over a WebSocket to pseudo-terminals); a reload keeps every shell and its screen.

features.name: Tabs and split panes
features.description: Each tab holds a tree of panes, each its own shell; Ctrl+Shift+D / E split, Ctrl+Shift+arrows move focus, dividers drag, the layout survives a reload.

features.name: Find in scrollback
features.description: Ctrl+Shift+F: live match count, highlights, match case, whole word and regular expression.

features.name: Tab names
features.description: Double-click a tab (or right-click > Rename tab) to name it; an empty name goes back to the program or folder; names survive a reload.

features.name: Activity and bell marks
features.description: A tab behind the one in front gets an accent dot when it prints something and an amber dot when a program rings the bell (Claude Code can); opening the tab clears it.

features.name: Settings panel
features.description: The gear: text size and scrollback lines (slider plus number box), cursor style, blinking cursor, copy on select, back to defaults; built from the PREFS list in static/app.js.

features.name: Safe big pastes
features.description: Input the shell has not read yet waits in a queue instead of blocking the backend; Ctrl+C while a paste is still going in drops the rest and interrupts the program.

features.name: Calm reconnects
features.description: If the backend goes away, one shared retry (1.5 s doubling to 30 s, paused while hidden) asks for a fresh token and only then reopens the lost panes.

known_gaps: Shells end when Forge closes (no detached host process yet).
Not yet seen inside the owner's Forge window (WebKitGTK); checked in headless Chrome.
